root_config.author_packet_selection: TRAIN metadata only: SHA-ordered first three DIMACS sources and first three SATLIB sources, then both sides of the SHA-ordered first source pair in each of the six temporal regime/horizon families; 18 states. No quality or conditional-label filtering.
root_config.quality_normalization: Macro-average across the eight TRAIN families of exact feasible reward / total graph weight; this denominator is neither optimum nor a feasible best-method reference.
root_config.all_arms_share: Initializer, targets/regions, patch construction, include-first traversal, bounds and all caps. Program priority changes only the local feasible greedy proposal and pivot vertex.
root_config.cap_scope: Cooperative end-to-end nominal wall time and charged-operation cap; final incumbent validation is charged and any overshoot reported. An ordinary budget stop retains the feasible incumbent.

timing_scope: Kernel starts before AST/init; task includes reconstruction; batch wall separately includes interpreter/import/verification/pool startup and receipts
